name: PUMP SHOTGUN
_note: The room-clearing verb. `damage` is the FULL TRIGGER PULL, split evenly across `pellets` (7 x 8): every pellet is scattered independently inside the LIVE spread cone and resolved as its own ray, so a partial cone does partial damage and the crosshair ring IS the pellet cone. bloom is deliberately ZERO — a pump has no spray to punish, its governors are the 0.75 s cycle, a 0.055 rad muzzle climb, and the shortest falloff in the game (full bite to 8 m, 12% past 30 m). Point-blank all-7 = 56, so a 60hp cruiser dies in two shells and an officer goes down to any 3 pellets.
